name: kuku-daily-trailer
description: 30 s Remotion trailer for the Kuku Daily concept prototype. Every on-screen word comes from web/data.js.

scripts.studio: npm run data && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run data && remotion render src/index.ts Trailer ../web/trailer.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --muted --pixel-format=yuv420p
